# sherpa-group

A row, column or grid of controls that reads as ONE object.

| Category | layout |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-group><sherpa-button>Day</sherpa-button><sherpa-button>Week</sherpa-button><sherpa-button>Month</sherpa-button></sherpa-group>
```
